📖 How to use

      
  1. Type the tooltip text and pick a position (top, bottom, left, right).
  2. Choose the background color, text color and corner radius.
  3. Hover the demo button to preview it live.
  4. Click "Copy HTML + CSS" and paste both parts into your page.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does the tooltip need JavaScript?
Yes — everything is done with CSS :hover, so no JavaScript is required.
Can I attach it to my own button?
The tooltip uses a data-tip attribute; you can put it on any element (buttons, links, icons) by copying the attribute and class over.
Does it support long text?
The tooltip width caps at 220px with word wrapping, so longer text wraps into multiple lines automatically.
